description: Sibling-run block groups for code languages: a run of 2+ adjacent same-kind siblings (comments, #includes, #defines, imports) is one addressable block row. Totals pin corpus-wide synthesis against the frozen corpora — a scanner regression that silently stops emitting blocks (the array_block failure mode) drops these counts to zero and fails loudly. Exact-row cases pin one block per kind at its real location so line placement and per-file behaviour cannot drift unnoticed.

steps.fql: FIND symbols WHERE fql_kind = 'include_block' GROUP BY fql_kind
FIND symbols WHERE fql_kind = 'include_block' IN 'kernel/sched.c' LIMIT 1
FIND symbols WHERE fql_kind = 'macro_block' GROUP BY fql_kind
FIND symbols WHERE fql_kind = 'comment_block' GROUP BY fql_kind
FIND symbols WHERE fql_kind = 'import_block' GROUP BY fql_kind
FIND symbols WHERE fql_kind = 'import_block' IN 'torch/nn/modules/module.py' LIMIT 1
